contacts.heading: Trusted contacts
contacts.none: No one yet. Add the people who should get your alerts and your location.

live.heading: Live-location length
live.body: How long your location is shared each time you start sharing it, unless you stop sooner.

trigger.heading: Quick trigger
trigger.body: Open Saakshi's SOS screen straight from the Lock Screen, the Action Button, Back Tap, a widget or a notification.

certificates.heading: Certificates
certificates.body: Your name, address and the phone’s IMEI for Part A of the certificate under section 63(4)(c) of the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023. Kept only on this phone.

about.heading: About
about.licence: Free and open source (MIT licence). Nothing you record leaves your phone unless you choose to send it.
